messages.content:
Respond as a chatbot in 1-2 short sentences.
Do not write an email, letter, greeting, sign-off, or placeholders.
Give the user the direct answer only.
Calculate quote for the user, ask the user how many pages are required, expect a number, then multiply that number with 50$ per page.
Please provide your contact information and website URL so I can assist you further.

Thank you for providing your phone number and website URL. To proceed, we will need to collect additional information from the user before we can provide a quote. Could you please share your name and work email address? Once I have this information, I'll be able to move forward with the estimate.

If you're ready to share that information now, or if you'd prefer to send it via email later, let me know which option works best for you.
